recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1970s cosmic illustration featuring a central, 3D extruded metallic emblem floating in a deep indigo starfield, characterized by sharp lens flares and a glowing yellow border.
coreVisualRelationships: The central chrome emblem acts as the primary light source for the surrounding space dust.
The vibrant yellow border contains the dark, expansive cosmic background.
Sharp white glints contrast against the warm gold and cool silver metallic surfaces.
coreInvariants: Deep indigo to black gradient background
Heavy 3D extrusion on all typographic elements
Four-pointed star lens flares on metallic highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary emblem is centered, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'K' and 'C' initials serve as the dominant focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright glints on the initials, move down to the arched secondary text, and then follow the diagonal star trail into the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive dark space around the central cluster creates a sense of depth and isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark void and the reflective, saturated gold surfaces.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and script hybrid
letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D depth with a 45-degree upward extrusion
Double-lined internal borders on main initials
Metallic gradient fills simulating chrome reflections
characterSpecificRedesigns: Secondary text uses a flared sans-serif with rounded corners and heavy depth
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A dominant, complex 3D logo paired with a simpler, arched 3D sub-headline.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab foundation for the initials.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep indigo cosmic starfield with a diagonal cluster of stars and a solid yellow border frame. Leave the center empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom 3D extruded chrome lettering in gold and silver. Add four-pointed white star glints on the sharpest corners of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D extrusion consistent across all letters?
Does the yellow border maintain a uniform width?
Are the star glints placed only on highlights?
Is the background a smooth indigo gradient?

avoid: Overly bright purple or pink nebulae

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text appears to float in space.
Ensure the gold color is vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the 3D depth does not obscure the letterforms.
Confirm the yellow border is perfectly rectangular.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Cosmic Indigo Starfield] with a [Solid Yellow Frame] and center a [3D Gold Chrome Custom Emblem] with [Four-Pointed Glints].
